description.zh: 看具名合集图形，再核提供件的版本许可。 按图标合集浏览样张，提供跨库检索入口，可比较同形图稿的线框、实心与细节差异。IconShelf Basic免费访问带搜索及下载额度；具体图稿许可、商用与完整应用源码尚未确认，本次未测试检索、下载或导出。
description.en: An icon entry with collection browsing and search, showing outline and filled samples from multiple libraries. The IconShelf Basic plan is free with search and download quotas; individual icon licenses, commercial permissions, and complete application source remain unverified.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by IconShelf (https://iconshelf.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看具名合集图形，再核提供件的版本许可。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先比较 Phosphor 的轮廓、Material 的实心与 Tabler 的细线，再进 Lucide 看波形和警示图形。建议按合集选描边体系；卡内有同形变体与空槽，不把它们当新增独立图标。这个入口适合选图时比较风格，IconShelf Basic 免费但有额度；本次未测试检索或导出，原图稿许可、商用和完整应用源码仍未知。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
